job.title: Operations Project Manager
job.description:
ROLE DETAILS
  • Location: Melbourne, VIC
  • Start Date: ASAP
  • Contract: Initial 6-month temporary assignment, with potential to extend to 12 months
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
  • Working Arrangements: Melbourne CBD, Office based; WFH arrangements to be confirmed
  • Salary: $70-$80 p/h + Super DOE
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Join a well-established Australian organisation with a significant national presence and a complex, fast-moving operational environment. With teams working collaboratively across multiple locations, this business is focused on continuously improving how services are delivered. You'll work alongside experienced leaders who value initiative, practical problem-solving and collaboration, with the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects that make a real difference to day-to-day operations.
 
ABOUT THE ROLE
An exciting opportunity for an experienced Operations Project Manager to drive multiple national projects spanning operational readiness, service improvement and business transformation. Reporting to a General Manager, you'll coordinate complex site operations, service model redesign and a CRM migration, working closely with operational leaders, a Business Analyst and external partners. You'll own project plans, manage competing priorities and bring stakeholders together to ensure key initiatives are delivered successfully.
 
DUTIES
  • Lead the coordination of national operational readiness planning across multiple states and sites, working with state teams to consolidate trading hours, road closures, staffing, security coverage, pricing changes and major event requirements.
  • Establish clear project plans and responsibilities, bringing together cross-functional stakeholders to agree on deliverables, dependencies and deadlines.
  • Drive a national field service improvement project, coordinating the review of technician coverage, service hours, resource allocation and escalation processes.
  • Support an operational transformation program, managing project plans, stakeholder engagement, vendor dependencies and key deliverables.
  • Coordinate a CRM platform migration, working with an external implementation partner and internal stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Manage multiple concurrent project workstreams, proactively following up on actions, resolving coordination challenges and ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with state operational leaders and offshore support teams, ensuring operational decisions, service changes and critical information are communicated accurately.
  • Maintain project plans, trackers and portfolio reporting, providing senior leadership with clear updates on project progress, outstanding actions, risks and decisions.
  • Partner with a Business Analyst and cross-functional teams to translate project requirements into practical delivery plans and coordinated outcomes.
 SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
  • Proven experience in project management, operational project delivery or a similar hands-on project leadership role.
  • Demonstrated project delivery experience within customer operations, service delivery, field services or multi-site operational environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, operational teams and external partners.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Excellent planning, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive projects through to completion.
  • Confident communicator who can bring together stakeholders across different teams, locations and functions.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using project management or tracking tools.
  • Exposure to vendor transitions, outsourced service models, operational transformation or CRM migrations highly regarded.
  • Formal project management qualifications such as PRINCE2 or PMP welcomed but not essential.
 BENEFITS
  • Initial 6-month temporary contract with potential to extend to 12 months.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of diverse operational and transformation projects.
  • Work directly with senior leadership and contribute to national business initiatives.
  • Enjoy genuine autonomy, variety and the opportunity to influence service delivery improvements.
  • Collaborate with experienced professionals across operations, technology and service delivery.
  • Join an established organisation where your contribution will make a tangible impact.

job.description:
Job Title
Recruitment Consultant

Job Type
Permanent

Job Location
Sydney NSW 2000

Salary
$75,000-$100,000
  
As a Recruitment Consultant, you’ll be responsible for:
  • Managing an existing temporary pool of placed candidates
  • Taking job briefs, posting job ads, interviewing candidates and liaising with clients throughout the sourcing process
  • Reviewing applications and phone screening potential candidates
  • Using your initiative to source high-quality candidates in very short time frames
  • Conducting regular check-ins with registered and placed candidates
  • Conducting reference checks and updating the CRM
  
Business Development;
  • Maintaining strong relationships with existing clients
  • Building a strong business development strategy to target and win key clients
  • Sourcing and following leads to make calls to drive new business development
  • Meeting existing and prospective clients to drive business growth
  
This is a 360-degree consultant role focused on the recruitment of temporary candidates within business support, HR, Marketing, and project support. We work with a number of industry sectors including education, health, commercial and FMCG.

In order to be successful in this high-performing environment, you will be a self-starter, team-oriented in how you work, happy to recruit at a very fast pace, value relationships above all else and hold yourself to very high standards of work. A flair for administration, you will understand the importance of process within temporary recruitment, and bring with you a number of years of experience in a 360-degree recruitment position.
  
Our next team member will not just be looking for a job, they are looking to be part of a team that really cares about what they do.
  
Sounding good so far? Well, let's talk about the benefits!
  
We work hard, however, we always celebrate the wins and have fun along the way with exciting incentives and a range of benefits, including:
  • Above market commission structure

  • Group volunteering activities
  • Opportunity to get involved in charity initiatives through our partnership with Stepping Stone House - a charity supporting disadvantaged young people to help break the cycle of homelessness
  • Internal mentoring program
  • Genuine opportunities for growth and development
  • A great office vibe! - Music, snacks, a 'dress for your day' dress code and an inclusive, friendly environment
